title: Northwest Bigfoot Battle Opens 2026-27 Folkstyle Tour of America; 95 Champions Crowned in Spokane
excerpt: SPOKANE, Washington – A new season of the USA Wrestling Folkstyle Tour of America Series launched over the weekend with spirited competition in the boys' and girls' folkstyle divisions at the Northwest Bigfoot Battle. Tournaments were held from the Mid...
